content.text:
I fixed it with a one-line change to `packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownLinks.ts`.

**Cause:** The code that turns Markdown file links into page URLs (`[x](doc.md)` → `/docs/doc`) matched any link containing `.md` or `.mdx`, even when the extension was in the middle of a path. So in `./file.md__static_image_assets__/image.png`, it treated the leading `./file.md` as a link to the page `file.md` and rewrote it into a docs URL. The image path ended up pointing somewhere that doesn't exist, which is why it was looked up in `/static` and the build failed.

**Fix:** I added a lookahead to the regex so `.md`/`.mdx` only counts as a file link when it's the end of the link target. That means it must be followed by whitespace, `)`, `>`, `#`, `?`, a quote, or the end of the line. Links like `doc.md#anchor` and `<doc.md>` still get converted. Paths where `.md` is just part of a directory name are left alone and handled as normal relative image paths.

**Verification:** The existing `markdownLinks` tests all pass (10 tests, 10 snapshots), and I rebuilt the package's `lib` output. I didn't add a test for this case or run the reproduction site end-to-end; I only checked the issue's exact path by reasoning through the regex.
